Veth pair creation into namespace.command: kind=veth; name=VETH_OUT; mtu=1080; group=GROUP; peer={name=VETH_IN, mtu=1080, NET_NS_PID=PID (Docker) or NET_NS_FD=NS_FD (standalone)}

Namespace address.command: nsenter -t PID -n ip addr add NS_IP/30 dev VETH_IN (Docker); standalone: nsenter --net=/var/run/netns/NS -- ip addr add NS_IP/30 dev VETH_IN

Namespace interface UP.command: nsenter -t PID -n ip link set VETH_IN up (Docker); standalone: nsenter --net=/var/run/netns/NS -- ip link set VETH_IN up

Namespace default route.command: nsenter --net=/var/run/netns/NS -- ip route add default via BRIDGE_IP

Bridge and veth lookup.command: IFLA_IFNAME=BRIDGE, then IFLA_IFNAME=VETH_OUT (two lookups per endpoint)

Bridge MTU and UP.command: index=BRIDGE_IFINDEX; IFLA_MTU=1080; IFF_UP flag and change bit

Four stale cross-host lookups.command: IFLA_IFNAME in {macsec-ID-s, macsec-ID-c, veth-ID-s, vxlan-NS}; four single-name lookups per endpoint

VXLAN creation.command: kind=vxlan; name=vxlan-NS; group=GROUP; IFLA_VXLAN_ID=VNI; LOCAL=LOCAL_IP; GROUP=REMOTE_IP; PORT=UDP_PORT

IPsec key derivation subprocess.command: sha256sum (stdin: ASCII KEY_HEX); take first 8 digest hex characters as salt; AEAD_KEY=0x + KEY_HEX + salt

IPsec state out.command: ip xfrm state add src LOCAL_IP dst REMOTE_IP proto esp spi SPI aead 'rfc4106(gcm(aes))' AEAD_KEY 128 mode transport

IPsec policy out.command: ip xfrm policy add src LOCAL_IP dst REMOTE_IP proto udp dport UDP_PORT dir out tmpl src LOCAL_IP dst REMOTE_IP proto esp spi SPI mode transport

IPsec state in.command: ip xfrm state add src REMOTE_IP dst LOCAL_IP proto esp spi SPI aead 'rfc4106(gcm(aes))' AEAD_KEY 128 mode transport

IPsec policy in.command: ip xfrm policy add src REMOTE_IP dst LOCAL_IP proto udp dport UDP_PORT dir in tmpl src REMOTE_IP dst LOCAL_IP proto esp spi SPI mode transport
